summary: This class explores the custom of reciting Tehillim chapter 67 in the shape of a menorah before Baruch Shemar. It discusses the history of this tradition from David HaMelekh and Abudraham, its role as a form of protection, and its prevalence in Sephardic communities.
questions: Why is Tehillim chapter 67 printed in the shape of a menorah?
How does reciting this Mizmor connect to the Bet HaMikdash?
What is the proper way to hold and read the menorah text?
How did David HaMelekh use this Psalm?
How was this custom practiced in Aleppo and other Sephardic communities?
